enzyme_family: FAD-dependent monooxygenase (tetracycline destructase, EC 1.14.13.231); class A flavoprotein monooxygenase
annotation: Catalyses regioselective C11a hydroxylation of tetracyclines; product unstable and decomposes non-enzymatically; downstream products lack antibacterial activity (functional loss demonstrated).

resistance_association.mechanism: enzymatic inactivation (tetX is itself a tetracycline resistance gene; confers resistance incl. tigecycline in family members)
resistance_association.databases: CARD lists tet(X) as resistance determinant
resistance_association.note: Deploying purified enzyme avoids gene transfer; deploying the organism/gene biocatalytically carries HGT risk.

structure.experimental_homolog: 4A6N (B. fragilis TetX + tigecycline, 2.3 A) exists; used as template context
structure.label: PREDICTED MODEL (AlphaFold) — not an experimentally solved structure

annotation: Functionally validated tetracycline-inactivating enzyme (confers resistance in aerobically grown E. coli); broad tetracycline substrate range.

structure.label: EXPERIMENTAL (X-ray, 3.1 A) — moderate resolution; ligand complex present

redock_validation.interpretation: PASS (RMSD <= 3.0 A): protocol reproduces crystallographic pose within tolerance
redock_validation.method: element-aware Hungarian assignment + Kabsch, heavy atoms (19 atom pairs); crystal pose has no CONECT records

interactions.note: Distance-based contacts from top docked pose; H-bonds inferred heuristically from geometry only.

docking.note: DOCKING != PROOF OF CATALYSIS. Computed with apo protein + FAD, box on co-crystal ligand site, seed 42.

organism: Pseudomonas aeruginosa (record); disseminated on plasmids across Acinetobacter/Enterobacterales
source_environment: clinical & animal isolates; mobile genetic elements
annotation: Plasmid-borne family variant conferring high-level tigecycline resistance; enzymatically inactivates tetracyclines (validated for family; variant-level kinetics reported).

degradation_evidence.status: experimentally-demonstrated (variant function shown; as biocatalyst it degrades tetracyclines)

resistance_association.mechanism: mobile tigecycline resistance gene — among the most clinically alarming tetracycline-inactivation determinants

structure.source: no direct experimental structure; strong homology to TetX/TetX2 (family)
structure.label: STRUCTURE UNAVAILABLE in prototype build — homology context only

annotation: Oxidises broad phenolic/aromatic substrates via single-electron transfer at T1 Cu; eliminates tetracyclines in vitro, substantially enhanced by mediators (e.g. HBT).

resistance_association.mechanism: no ARG association detected in analysed reference databases (fungal ligninolytic enzyme, no mobility elements)

docking.interpretation: No productive pose found at T1 copper channel under rigid docking (~0 kcal/mol across modes). Honest negative: rigid docking at this cavity does not capture laccase outer-sphere oxidation/mediator-assisted conversion. Docking absence of pose is NOT proof of non-catalysis; E2 evidence stands.

enzyme_family: Class II heme peroxidase (AA2 family, CAZy)
annotation: Oxidises Mn2+ to diffusible Mn3+, which oxidises organics remotely; crude MnP degrades tetracycline & oxytetracycline; pathway products reported (demethylation, dimethylamino oxidation, decarbonylation, hydroxylation, oxidative dehydrogenation).

resistance_association.mechanism: no ARG association detected in analysed databases

docking.note: Docking not mechanistically appropriate: oxidation is mediated by diffusible Mn3+ generated at a small Mn-binding site, not by substrate binding in a pocket. Substrate compatibility assessed from E2 literature instead.

protein_name: BSFL gut metatranscriptome candidate family (laccase-like AA1 / peroxidase AA2 / deacetylase)
source_environment: black soldier fly larval gut under 1250 mg/kg tetracycline
annotation: Family-level candidates upregulated under TC pressure; tet(X) NOT detected in BSFL gut; gut flora increases TC degradation rate ~3x (32.2% vs 11.5% germ-free). No individual protein sequence/activity validated yet.

degradation_evidence.status: strong functional-genomics evidence (community level); individual enzymes UNVALIDATED

resistance_association.mechanism: gut community simultaneously enriches efflux (tet(33), tetA, tetB, tetL, tetA(60)) and RPP (tetM, tetW) genes; selection-pressure context; the candidate ORFs themselves are not resistance genes

structure.label: STRUCTURE UNAVAILABLE — no resolved ORF sequence in this prototype build
